description: This file defines the ElvisBinary class in the Twig templating engine, representing a custom binary operator implementing the Elvis (ternary-like) operator with specific compilation logic.

classes.name: ElvisBinary
classes.description: A custom binary expression node in Twig implementing the Elvis operator (?:) for conditional logic within templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ElvisBinary node with left and right expressions and sets up internal nodes and attributes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the ElvisBinary node into PHP code using the provided compiler, translating the Elvis operator into a PHP ternary expression.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Elvis operator for use in compiled PHP code.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns the list of operand names that need to be escaped during compilation, here 'left' and 'right'.
